title: Run a manually selected bounded Solana CA batch
objective: Add one manual command that accepts 1 to 10 distinct Solana CAs supplied by the operator and runs the approved bounded Helius CA-first read for each. It must not discover CAs, schedule itself, retain provider payloads, persist results, or use a provider other than Helius.
forbidden_actions: Do not add cron, scheduler, background loops, automatic token discovery, provider fallback, database/cache writes, queues, address-library writes, or non-Solana chains.
Do not print, store, commit, or record credentials, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
Do not claim creator, Dev, address, holder-concentration, or full-analysis facts.
